Keeps the points of a las file with an intensity or elevation between two thresholds.

**Toolbox folder:** Lesto › filter<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** las, threshold, filter<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.lesto.modules.filter.LasThresholder`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inLas` | LAS file |  |  | The las file to filter. |
| `pLower` | Double |  |  | The lower threshold: the points with a lower value are removed. If not supplied, there is no lower limit. |
| `pUpper` | Double |  |  | The upper threshold: the points with a higher value are removed. If not supplied, there is no upper limit. |
| `pType` | String |  | `intensity` | The value of the points to compare with the thresholds. Allowed values: `intensity`, `elev`. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outLas` | output file |  | The las file of the kept points. |
